verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. Blessed is anyone who looks out for the poor. The LORD will rescue them when trouble hits.
The LORD will protect them and keep them alive. They'll be blessed in the land, and he won't hand them over to what their enemies want.
The LORD will hold them up on their sickbed and help them get back on their feet.
I said, “LORD, show me mercy! Heal me, because I've sinned against you.”
My enemies talk trash about me. “When will he die and his name disappear?”
If one comes to see me, he tells me lies and collects anything he can use against me. As soon as he leaves, he spreads it around.
Everyone who hates me gets together to whisper about me. They imagine the worst for me.
“Some awful disease has got him,” they say. “Now that he's down, he's never getting up.”
Even my close friend, the one I trusted and shared my bread with, turned against me.
But you, LORD, show me mercy and lift me back up so I can repay them.
I know you delight in me because my enemy doesn't get to celebrate a win over me.
You hold me up in my integrity and keep me in your presence forever.
Bless the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and amen. 🙌
